limitations: Original Bat checkout contains ignored .dev.vars; API runner overwrites this file and never restores an existing value. Independent clone prevents original config changes.
Vite dev proxy is fixed to production browser endpoint with Access service-token injection; concurrently started local Worker is not its proxy target.
Machine routes and auth scopes differ from browser APIs; CLI is private workspace, with assets-scoped token.
CLI heartbeat repeats supplied running/stopped values, not process discovery; macOS install only writes plist, no launchctl execution.
Actual retention setting is 1/7/30 days for raw, hourly, tier2 snapshots and events; old raw7/hourly90 constants do not drive purge.
R2 binary and checksum URL HEAD requests all returned 403 in this environment, so distribution availability was not verified. Source-build alternative documented.
Release uploads no install.sh; main releases Worker with migrations, tag-only job publishes probe binaries; VPS upgrades remain manual.
Optional KV paths fall back to D1; isolated tests do not exercise production KV cache consistency.
L3 setup ignores individual SQL failures and non-CI Playwright may reuse existing port, so startup output alone is not test proof.
